summary: Selecting job in ID computer automatically populates access numbers

comments.content:
Right now, unless you're an SS13 god or something you have to either guess
on the access numbers or look them up in the job descriptions when you're
assigning a job. Making the numbers automatically populated would be better.

Note this would be deprecated if Issue 59 is implemented.

http://code.google.com/p/ss13/issues/detail?id=59

Well, it'd automatically populate the appropriate set of permissions in that case.
Either way, it'd be very useful.
I've fixed this in my svn branch.
